mods.name: Tim (Trail Investigator Module)
mods.description: A Meteor Client addon built with AI featuring a handful of utilities for hunting.

releases.notes:
The "Hunting Utilities" addon is officially Tim (Trail Investigator Module). This update adds new modules, streamlined settings, and QoL improvements.

- Skipper
*Fixed portal skips spawning on trail edges by removing the loose trail-width fallback and adding continuous safety checks so active previews vanish when lava flows. Added TrackingFocus so 1.19+ lava columns aren't ignored, stripped Xaero map tooltips and solid color overrides so XaeroPlus renders natively.*

- Portal Maker
*now reliably auto-disables upon portal entry or dimension change when auto-recycle is turned off. It fixes early-stop bugs by checking against the exact thin portal pane VoxelShape instead of raw block coordinates, ensures Baritone walks fully to the center of the portal before stopping, and restricts missing throwaway block warnings to a single chat message per activation.*

- Inventory101
*Fixed tickAutoDrop for chat and enabled tickAutoTrash in containers.*

- Server Healthcare System (SHS)
*Fixed auto-eat in chat by allowing ChatScreen and using interactItem() to sync client-server eating state. Hooked up missing tickQuickRespawnMode() and updated inventory.*

- Rocket Pilot
*The new ignore-elytra option in RocketPilot keeps the module active and running its flight patterns and pitch controls even without an equipped elytra. This allows seamless integration when other modules manage chestplates or flight.*

- Dog Tag (new module)
*lightweight, chat-only recon module that scans nearby entities for custom nametags and tamed pets. It logs the mob’s type, sanitized name, and owner in chat without 3D boxes, HUDs, or coordinate leaks—even redacting coordinate-like numbers inside nametags. Since servers only send an owner's UUID to your client, DogTag checks the tab list first and queries [https://sessionserver.mojang.com/session/minecraft/profile/](https://sessionserver.mojang.com/session/minecraft/profile/) (Mojang’s official API) to resolve offline owners' usernames.*
